blurb: Stash 25.0 is the December 2020 release of Morgan Houppin's C UCI chess engine, adding Lazy SMP natively, check extensions, internal iterative reductions, a precomputed 2D LMR reduction table, and tuned futility pruning and evaluation weights. Adapted to UCI over WASI on the poll helper.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build using the C poll helper (Threads fixed to 1); Hash capped for 32-bit memory.

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: 64-bit magic bitboards for sliding-piece attack generation.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Iterative deepening PVS with quiescent capture search and TT cutoffs.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Depth- and eval-scaled null-move pruning with zugzwang verification search.

features.label: Internal Iterative Reductions
features.implementation: Reduces depth by one ply above depth 7 when no transposition-table move is present.

features.label: Check Extensions
features.implementation: Extends search depth by one ply on checking moves.

features.label: Table-Driven LMR
features.implementation: Precomputed 2D depth/move-count reduction table for late quiet moves.

features.label: Reverse Futility & Razoring
features.implementation: Tuned reverse futility pruning up to depth 8 and razoring up to depth 3.

features.label: Quiet History & Killers
features.implementation: Gravity-style quiet history updates paired with killers, TT move, MVV-LVA, and SEE.

features.label: Transposition Table
features.implementation: Shared Zobrist-indexed hash table storing search bounds, depths, and best moves.

features.label: King Zone Attack
features.implementation: Piece-weighted attacks on the safe king zone combined with pawn structure.

features.label: Space & Mobility
features.implementation: Safe-square mobility, open-file rooks, central space, and specialized endgame evaluators.

features.label: Tapered Eval
features.implementation: Tuned middlegame/endgame score pairs interpolated smoothly by game phase.
